deadline_class.audit_note: Uncalibrated independent HackRF IQ timelines cannot certify RF deadline compliance; decoded tasks without calibrated external reference bounds remain classified as unknown.

waveform_cost.scope: All slots including sync-only, repeats and failed DMA completions; successful DMA start allocates full waveform. Failed submissions listed separately; actual emitted fraction unknown. Padding is zero IQ, not proof of zero RF energy.

limitations: Waveform budgets and DMA completions are transmit proxies, not measured RF airtime or energy.
Independent BLE/IEEE HackRF IQ origins are uncalibrated; decoded tasks without a calibrated reference bound are marked deadline=unknown.
Software processing events are not physical actuator execution.
LC BLE ch39 (2480 MHz) differs in RF frequency from JC/SC BLE ch3 (2410 MHz); reliability differences cannot be attributed solely to packet format.
